title: Player Lives
description: A mod that adds customizable player lives to create a mix between hardcore and normal survival.
body:
# Player Lives

**A lightweight and customizable mod that adds player lives to Minecraft. Control how many lives each player gets, reset lives, or restore everyone at once. Perfect for SMPs, hardcore-style worlds, and event servers.**

## Description

Player Lives introduces a simple but powerful life system.
Each player has a configurable number of lives, and server admins can easily view or change them with commands.

### Great for:

- SMP servers that want added tension

- Hardcore-style modpacks with limited revives

- Event servers where elimination matters

- Lightweight life management for any server

> Works with permissions and integrates smoothly with other server management mods.

## Commands
**Set Maximum Lives**
```
/plives setMaxLives <amount>
```
> Sets the global maximum number of lives players can have.

**Get Maximum Lives**

```
/plives getMaxLives
```
> Shows the currently configured maximum lives.

**Set a Player’s Lives**

```
/plives player <playerName> setLives <amount>
```
> Sets a specific player’s current lives.

**Get a Player’s Lives**

```
/plives player <playerName> getLives
```
> Checks how many lives a specific player currently has.

**Restore All Players to Max Lives**

```
/plives maxAll
```
> Gives every player the maximum number of lives.
